title: Typing in a lazy continuation line of a quote adds the quote's prefix to it

expected.rationale: Only the edited characters should change in the source. The line without `>` is a lazy continuation of the quote's paragraph in CommonMark and in VFM, so it reads the same without the prefix the save adds.

knownLimitation.reason: A rewritten paragraph gives its lazy lines the prefix of the container

hypothesis: A rewritten paragraph gives its lazy lines the prefix of the container
